mcp_entry_g2_outcome_unknown.description: The second-generation MCP entry's child ended while this request was in flight, so whether it ran is unknown; the entry never sends it again, and the next request goes to a fresh child.
mcp_entry_g2_outcome_unknown.common_causes: The actinglab-mcp child exited or was ended while it was answering.
mcp_entry_g2_outcome_unknown.handling: Inspect before anything is sent again: ac_run_show for a run's request_id, otherwise ac_status.

mcp_entry_g2_child_unavailable.description: The second-generation MCP entry could not start or reach an actinglab-mcp child for this request, which was not sent.
mcp_entry_g2_child_unavailable.common_causes: Neither <root>\runtime\actinglab-mcp.exe nor <root>\tools\actinglab-mcp.exe exists or starts, or the child refused the replayed handshake.
mcp_entry_g2_child_unavailable.handling: Read the entry's status file (mcp-entry list) and stderr; the next request tries a fresh child.

mcp_entry_g2_usage_invalid.description: The second-generation MCP entry was started without --root, with an unknown flag or client, or without the -- that ends its own words.
mcp_entry_g2_usage_invalid.common_causes: A client configuration that does not follow the second generation's registration.
mcp_entry_g2_usage_invalid.handling: Register the entry as contracts/install-cli.md, "The MCP entry", gives it: --root <root>, optionally --client <client>, then -- and the server's own words.

mcp_entry_outcome_unknown.description: Retired (Workflow #434 LAB-7): the MCP entry's first generation (apps/mcp-entry) is deleted with its child actingctl mcp-serve, and its codes are kept here, with the generation that replaces it. Was: the MCP entry's child ended while this request was in flight, so whether it ran is unknown; the entry never sends it again, and the next request goes to a fresh child.
mcp_entry_outcome_unknown.common_causes: The actingctl mcp-serve child exited or was ended while it was answering.
mcp_entry_outcome_unknown.handling: Inspect before anything is sent again: ac_get_run for a run's request_id, otherwise ac_overview.

mcp_entry_child_unavailable.description: Retired (Workflow #434 LAB-7): the MCP entry's first generation (apps/mcp-entry) is deleted with its child actingctl mcp-serve, and its codes are kept here, with the generation that replaces it. Was: the MCP entry could not start or reach an actingctl mcp-serve child for this request, which was not sent.
mcp_entry_child_unavailable.common_causes: <root>\runtime\actingctl.exe is missing or does not start, or it refused the replayed handshake.
mcp_entry_child_unavailable.handling: Read the entry's status file (actingctl mcp-entry list) and stderr; the next request tries a fresh child.

mcp_entry_usage_invalid.description: Retired (Workflow #434 LAB-7): the MCP entry's first generation (apps/mcp-entry) is deleted, and its codes are kept here, with the generation that replaces it. Was: the MCP entry was started without --root, with an unknown flag or client, or without the child arguments after --.
mcp_entry_usage_invalid.common_causes: A client configuration that does not follow actingctl mcp-config --entry.
mcp_entry_usage_invalid.handling: Register the entry with the snippet actingctl mcp-config --entry prints.
